note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), the original being in English; only the alate is recorded, soldier and worker not described in the original; synonymy lists, figure numbers, measurement tables and distribution records not translated, and the density of wing membrane microstars was lost to OCR and not recorded.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule blackish brown, with a dark brown longitudinal stripe between the two ocelli on the front; postclypeus and pronotum yellowish brown; antennae pale; wings faintly brownish, transparent; abdominal tergites brown, sternites paler with yellow in the middle; legs brownish yellow. Head and body with dense short hairs and some long hairs. Body length with wings 14.6–14.7, without wings 7.5–8.1 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (to mandibular base 0.90–0.97, greatest width including eyes 1.20 mm); area around the frontal plate slightly concave; frontal suture absent; in front of the frontal plate a minute pale raised spot, and in front of each ocellus an oval spot. Frontal plate oval, rather large (length 0.13, width 0.09–0.10 mm), depressed. Compound eyes subcircular (maximum diameter 0.31–0.33 mm), projecting. Ocelli oval, semitransparent; distance to the compound eye about half the short diameter (long diameter 0.13–0.15, short diameter 0.11, eye–ocellus distance 0.05 mm), distance to the antenna equal to the short diameter. Postclypeus slightly convex, hairy, length less than half its width (length 0.18–0.20, width 0.53 mm); anteclypeus hairless, semitransparent, middle projecting forward. Antennae 15-segmented, segments 3, 4 and 5 subequal in length. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, slightly raised anteriorly (length 0.67, width 1.10–1.17 mm); anterior margin nearly straight or slightly concave, without a median notch; posterior margin slightly incurved in the middle. Legs slender and hairy; tibial apical spurs 2:2:2 or 3:2:2, dorsal spur of the fore tibia present or absent. Wings transparent, anterior and posterior margins each with a row of papillae; wing membrane covered with simple 2- or 3-pronged microstars (length 4–5, width 2–2.5 μm); venation as in the genus. Fore wing including scales 12.2–12.3, hind wing including scales 11.6 mm.
